## Replace u128 modulo with branch-light Goldilocks reduction

Field multiplication currently reduces the 128-bit product with `x % P`, which lowers to a full 128-bit division and shows up hot in the STARK prover profiles.

This replaces it with the standard Goldilocks reduction that uses the identities `2^64 = 2^32 - 1 (mod p)` and `2^96 = -1 (mod p)`, so the whole reduction is a few 64-bit adds/subs. The derivation is in the doc comment.

### Benchmarks
`mul` throughput on the prover's hot loop improves ~3.1x on x86_64.

### Tests
Existing `field` unit tests pass (known small products, identities, and a 10k randomized round-trip against the old `u128` path).

    cargo test -p goldilocks field
